title: UpdateManifest
description: A signed worker release manifest (protocols.md §7, ADR 13). The coordinator produces it; the worker verifies the signature against a pinned public key before touching a byte. The signature (ECDSA P-256 / SHA-256, base64 DER) covers the newline-joined version, rid, sha256, channel — pinning a specific artifact by sha256.

sha256.description: Artifact digest; the worker verifies the download against it.

protocol_version.description: Queue-contract protocol the release speaks (skew gating).
